Broadcom published fiscal Q1 2026 results on March 4, 2026.
The quarter ended on February 1, 2026.
Total revenue was USD 19.311 billion.
Total revenue increased 29% year over year.
AI semiconductor revenue was USD 8.4 billion.
AI semiconductor revenue increased 106% year over year.
Adjusted EBITDA was USD 13.128 billion.
Adjusted EBITDA margin was 68% of revenue.
GAAP diluted EPS was USD 1.50.
Non-GAAP diluted EPS was USD 2.05.
Operating cash flow was USD 8.260 billion.
Capital expenditure was USD 0.250 billion.
Free cash flow was USD 8.010 billion.
For the next quarter, management guided total revenue to approximately USD 22.0 billion.
Management guided AI semiconductor revenue to USD 10.7 billion.
This guidance is a company forecast. It is not a historical fact.

This document is a retrospective reconstruction.
It was not written before the fiscal Q2 2026 earnings release.
It uses only the fiscal Q1 2026 press release.

Preview conclusion:
The fiscal Q1 2026 report supports a strong fiscal Q2 outlook.
The main questions are AI semiconductor growth, EBITDA margin, and free cash flow.
Positive difference: total revenue above USD 22.0 billion, or AI semiconductor revenue above USD 10.7 billion, could support the AI demand outlook.
Negative difference: AI semiconductor revenue below USD 10.7 billion, or adjusted EBITDA margin clearly below 68%, could weaken the margin and cash flow view.
Verification points: check actual total revenue, actual AI semiconductor revenue, adjusted EBITDA margin, and free cash flow.

reader_questions: 问题1：公司指引中的约220亿美元总收入是否来自同一份Q1新闻稿？回答：是；该指引与AI半导体收入107亿美元都出自同一份Q1 FY2026新闻稿。
问题2：AI半导体收入是GAAP分部收入还是管理层口径？回答：本稿按管理层口径引用，未将其等同于GAAP分部收入。
问题3：文中的43.5%和48.6%是什么占比？回答：分别是8.4/19.311和10.7/22.0的简单比值，表示AI半导体收入占当季或下季指引总收入的百分比，不是利润率。
